动名词与不定式辨析:remember / forget / stop / try: 同一动词,后面跟 doing 还是 to do,意思会发生转向,是 B1 的经典考点。
remember doing 记得做过 / remember to do 记得要去做|forget doing 忘了做过 / forget to do 忘了要去做|stop doing 停止做 / stop to do 停下去做另一件|try doing 尝试做 / try to do 努力做|go on doing 继续同一件事 / go on to do 接着做另一件
Remember to lock the door tonight.
He forgot to bring his badge.
column3: 他忘了带工牌。(该做没做)

动名词与不定式辨析:remember / forget / stop / try: She stopped drinking coffee at night.
column3: 她不再在晚上喝咖啡了。

动名词与不定式辨析:remember / forget / stop / try: Let's try adding a little honey.

# title: I will never forget ___ Paris for the first time.
column4: 忘不了"已发生"的经历,用 doing。
别忘了"要去做",用 to do。

# title: On the way home we stopped ___ some bread.
column4: 停下来去买面包,目的用 to do。

# title: I tried ___ the window, but it was stuck.
column4: 努力去开窗,用 try to do。

# title: She tried ___ yoga to relax, and it worked.
column4: 尝试(一种方法)做瑜伽,用 try doing。

# title: After the break, we went on ___ the report.
column4: 休息后接着做另一件事,用 go on to do。
